propositions: The fourth named extraction from ADR 0056 (build_agent_kwargs and post-call telemetry blocks) must be relocated from PydanticAIRunner.run() into a new leaf module agent_call.py to reduce run() method body from 342 LOC to approximately 300 LOC

build_agent_kwargs must consolidate four separated kwargs-building fragments (tool_step_limit rewrite, base dict, capabilities key, model_settings key) into a single function call, with web_caps passed in to preserve monkeypatch.setattr() contract
log_call_success and record_call_spend blocks must be extracted as separate functions respecting the constraint that finalize_outcome can raise, so the success log must emit before finalization
The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain at its current location in runner.py to prevent silent defeat of test suite monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) patches
agent_call.py must clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor, import nothing from runner at runtime, and introduce zero required monkeypatch repoints
The extraction is a pure relocation with no logic changes, no public API changes, and no modified or deleted test assertions
